messages:
arjun: PagerDuty alert hit for Manganex VPC canary - high 5xx rate on /v1/generate. PD: https://pd.example/incidents/P12345. Paging eng-sre and eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT P12345 - manganex-prod-vpc - threshold breach: error_rate > 10% over 2m. Notifying: @leah (eng-sre oncall), @arjun (eng-oncall).

leah: I'm on it. summary?

sam: Customer support reported 503s starting ~2026-03-15 08:12 UTC. They saw request ids failing with 503s and retry storms.

arjun: Observed in metrics: canary pool (manganex-canary-d1) error_rate=18%, p95 latency spike from 120ms -> 980ms. Canary rollout started at 08:07 UTC (artifact model-serving:v2.9 sha=abc123) and currently at 5% traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary metadata: customer=manganex, pool=manganex-dedicated-d1, artifact=model-serving:v2.9 (sha:abc123), rollout: 5%, started: 2026-03-15T08:07:23Z.

leah: Can someone paste a failing log from a canary instance? need to know error surface.

infra-bot: Pulling logs from canary node i-0f123... attaching snippet.

infra-bot: ```
2026-03-15T08:11:45Z ERROR router] request_id=req_9f8a handler=generate status=503 backend=worker-12 error="kv-cache key mismatch: expected 0x3a, got 0x7f"
2026-03-15T08:11:45Z ERROR worker-12] trace_id=tr_8221 runtime_error: tensor-quantization: buffer size mismatch
```

leah: kv-cache mismatch + quantization buffer error. Likely incompatible build variant with optimized kernels for this customer's VM image. Matches a model-serving build we recently enabled with experimental kernel selection.

rana: Manganex CS: "We're seeing intermittent 503s in production across a subset of users. Some requests succeed after retry but overall experience degraded." They're asking for ETA and mitigations.

leah: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pin customer traffic back to previous pinned artifact (model-serving:v2.8 sha=9f7d2). 2) Quarantine canary pool (0% new sessions). 3) If pinback fails, scale up fallback pool and route traffic there.

arjun: Agreed. I'll run the pinback revert command. will broadcast when complete.

arjun: Executing: `rbe deploy revert --customer manganex --pool manganex-dedicated-d1 --artifact sha:9f7d2 --reason "canary kv-cache mismatch causing 503s"`

deploy-bot: Received revert request, starting orchestrated rollback. Rolling canary pool to sha:9f7d2. Estimated completion 2m.

leah: While that's running, set routing rule to 0% canary traffic to avoid new sessions landing on canary: `rbe routing set --customer manganex --pool manganex-dedicated-d1 --canary 0`

infra-bot: Routing update applied. Snapshot: `routing: {canary:0, stable:100, fallback:0}`

sam: Notifying customer that we're reverting canary and expect degraded requests to subside within ~3-5 minutes. CS pinged Manganex support channel.

deploy-bot: Revert complete on all canary nodes. Current artifact on manganex-dedicated-d1 = model-serving:v2.8 (sha:9f7d2).

leah: Running quick smoke tests against the pool and sampling traces.

infra-bot: Smoke result: 200/200 sample requests succeeded, p95 latency back to 110ms, error_rate < 0.5% over last 1m.

rana: Customer updated: "We see traffic normalized, thanks."

arjun: Marking incident as mitigated. Next actions: - create short postmortem, include root cause hypothesis (kernel selection + artifact incompatibility on Manganex VM image), define guardrails (auto-canary rollback on kv-cache mismatch, additional preflight kernel compatibility check), and schedule RCA with builds/serving.

leah: I'll own the postmortem. Handing oncall to arjun for the next 30m (any follow-ups, escalate to leah).

arjun: Taking oncall. tagging @ops-runbook: add a runbook entry for pinned-artifact-rollbacks for VPC customers.

leah: Filed incident P12345 in tracker and added timeline. We'll follow up with a patchrelease and extra canary checks before reattempting v2.9.

sam: Closing the customer comms loop. Thanks all. :tada:

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 status: mitigated -> resolved by leah at 2026-03-15T08:32:60Z.

leah: Postmortem next steps: schedule 1-hr sync with infra-builds + serving runtime tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll add owners and action items.

arjun: Great work.
